sections.Business: Nimbus AI, Inc. develops enterprise agentic-AI software that automates back-office knowledge work. Our platform orchestrates large language models to complete multi-step tasks across a customer's existing systems. As of December 31, 2024 we served 210 enterprise customers, up from 74 a year earlier.
sections.Risk Factors: We have a limited operating history and have incurred significant net losses since inception. We depend on a small number of third-party model providers, and an interruption in access to their models, or a material increase in their prices, could harm our business. A significant portion of our revenue is concentrated among our ten largest customers.
sections.Management's Discussion and Analysis: Revenue increased to $42.0 million in fiscal 2024 from $18.5 million in fiscal 2023, an increase of 127%. The increase was driven primarily by expansion within existing enterprise customers. Net loss was $30.1 million in fiscal 2024 compared to a net loss of $21.4 million in fiscal 2023.
sections.Use of Proceeds: We intend to use the net proceeds of this offering for research and development, expansion of our go-to-market organization, and general corporate purposes.

sections.Business: Corvus Semiconductors designs energy-efficient inference accelerators for AI data centers. Our flagship CV-2 accelerator targets transformer inference workloads.
sections.Risk Factors: We rely on a single third-party foundry to manufacture our products. Our largest customer accounted for 38% of revenue in fiscal 2024, and the loss of this customer would materially harm our results.
sections.Management's Discussion and Analysis: Revenue was $310.5 million in fiscal 2024 compared to $402.7 million in fiscal 2023, a decrease of 23% driven by a cyclical downturn in data-center capital spending. Gross margin was 54.1%.
